login.title: Paste your API token
login.body: The bearer token was generated by `make up` and written to `.env.local` at the repo root. Open it in a text editor and paste the value after `SHP_API_TOKEN=` below.
login.invalid: That token didn't unlock the API. Double-check `.env.local`.

mode.title: Agent mode
mode.description: Flip the kill-switch. observe-only and frozen deny every action at the OPA gate.

confirm.title: Switch to {{mode}} mode?
confirm.body: The new mode takes effect on the next event. The mode change itself is written to the audit log.

usecases.title: Use Cases
usecases.subtitle: Saved synthetic scenarios with expectations. Use these to drive demos or regression-check the agent on a specific shape of incident.
usecases.empty: No use cases yet. Create one to seed a custom scenario.

context.name: Name
context.namePlaceholder: Short, unique identifier (e.g., "Memory leak in nginx-demo")
context.descriptionEnPlaceholder: What this case demonstrates, in markdown.
context.descriptionFrPlaceholder: Ce que ce cas illustre, en markdown.
context.tagsPlaceholder: Type a tag and press Enter

target.noLabels: No labels yet. Add at least one to match a pod.

expected.description: Expectations are evaluated after the use case runs. They aren't hard tests — the LLM is non-deterministic — just a sanity check.
expected.keywordPlaceholder: Type a keyword and press Enter (e.g., "OOMKilled")

runbook.description: Optional. When provided, the runbook is embedded into Qdrant just before the case runs, tagged with the use-case id. The diagnose node will see it among the top RAG hits.
